title: Delicious Monster website, 2009
lede: The page for Delicious Library 2, archived June 2009: a wood-grain header with vector flowers above olive panels, and a screenshot of the app’s wooden shelves.
summary: Orange wood grain, vector flowers and a skyline, olive panels, and a shelf screenshot.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The archived page may lack some images or scripts that the live page had.

styles.note: Borderline: the wood-grain header matches the style’s materials and the page shows the app’s bookshelf, but the vector flowers and flat olive panels come from mid-2000s illustration, not from an object metaphor.

observed: A large rounded header shows orange and brown wood grain with a monster mascot, a “2.1” speech bubble, and a vector skyline with flowers and birds.
Below, olive green panels with thin yellow lines hold the navigation (Library, Company, Help, Buy $40, Download) in small capitals.
A yellow box holds a screenshot of Delicious Library 2 with book and comic covers on three wooden shelves.
Feature buttons are olive rectangles with small round icons, divided by a stem-like line with a blue flower.
interpretation: All metrics except radius fail: the wood grain and panels are bitmap images (49% image share), so no gradient, pattern, or shadow is measured.
borrow: Pair a real wood-grain header with the product’s own shelf screenshot to connect the site and the app.

images.alt: Archived Delicious Monster page: an orange wood-grain header with a monster mascot, a 2.1 badge, and a vector skyline with flowers, above olive panels with navigation, a screenshot of Delicious Library 2 showing covers on wooden shelves, and feature buttons.
images.caption: First viewport of the [archived copy](https://web.archive.org/web/20090618031638/http://www.delicious-monster.com/).
